title: Pruning–splicing reciprocity (PSR) model of idiopathic autism: code and derived data (v1.0.0)
description: Code, derived data, posterior samples, simulation outputs and figures reproducing the manuscript 'Where does the loop begin? A calibrated pruning–splicing model and in-silico trial specify the longitudinal design needed to stratify idiopathic autism'. Includes a calibrated biophysical model (ABC), validation against BrainSpan and three GEO post-mortem autism cohorts, SFARI genetic-loading analysis and an in-silico longitudinal trial with a maximum-likelihood RI-CLPM.
